# BoldLine Media

> BoldLine Media is a Phoenix, Arizona agency that plans, builds, and runs Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns, plus the custom landing pages behind them and the business's website, for service businesses anywhere in the US. Clients always own and are billed directly for their own ad account; BoldLine only manages it and never holds or fronts ad spend. Ad management starts at $400/month; websites start at $1,500 to build. most clients run about $1,000/month or more in ad budget, paid directly to Google or Meta.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://boldlinemedia.com/): what BoldLine does, in short.
- [Ads](https://boldlinemedia.com/ads/): how we plan, build and run Google and Meta ads, and track every lead back to the ad.
- [Websites](https://boldlinemedia.com/websites/): websites we design, build and host, with or without ads.
- [Pricing](https://boldlinemedia.com/pricing/): every package and what it costs.
- [How it works](https://boldlinemedia.com/how-it-works/): how an engagement runs, who it fits, and the FAQ.
- [About](https://boldlinemedia.com/about/): who runs BoldLine and why it's paid on results.
- [Free Lead-Leak Check](https://boldlinemedia.com/free-check/): a free look at where a business's website is losing customers.
- [Contact](https://boldlinemedia.com/contact/): send a message.
- [Get Started](https://boldlinemedia.com/get-started/): request a free strategy call.
- [Blog](https://boldlinemedia.com/blog/): plain-English marketing tips for service businesses (Google Ads, Meta Ads, landing pages, lead follow-up).

## Services
- Google Ads management
- Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads management
- Custom landing pages built to convert
- Call tracking and CRM lead routing
- Websites: designed, built and hosted, with or without ads

## Who it's for
Service businesses that want steady, predictable leads without managing ads themselves.

## Owner
Bryson Weiser, founder. BoldLine keeps a small client roster on purpose, so clients work directly with the founder, not a junior account manager.
